brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Georgia extradited a U.S.-Uzbek citizen wanted for terrorism support to the United States. [1]
Agrobank Venture Fund launched with $6.1 million to support startups in Uzbekistan. [3]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR UZBEKISTAN
The extradition of a U.S.-Uzbek citizen for terrorism support highlights security concerns despite the country's low government travel advisory rating. [1][E1]

KEY RISKS
Uzbekistan's link to 25 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations poses a risk for international business dealings. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the C5+1 talks led by Rubio with a major U.S. business delegation to Uzbekistan remains unresolved. [4]
